free_tier.stated: GPU marketplace that aggregates capacity from multiple data center partners, with no free allowance: the first step after signup is to add credits, 'minimum $15 by card or $50 by crypto, maximum $5,000 per transaction'. Cheapest live on-demand rate per GPU-hour on the pricing page: H100 $2.98 (spot $2.79), A100 80 GB $1.43 (spot $1.19), L40S $0.96, RTX 4090 $0.48; L4 is not listed. The pricing page states a 20-minute minimum runtime on every instance (60 minutes on a 2x AMD MI300X) and per-minute billing after it; the billing docs state pay-per-second billing

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: USD 15 at USD 0.52 per hour is about 28 hours of one RTX 4090, so a single minimum deposit funds a week of evening experiments; the deposit is prepaid balance, not a credit grant.

limits.value: Nothing runs before a deposit of at least USD 15 by card or USD 50 by crypto clears; there is no trial credit, so the first gate is money rather than identity.

identity_cost.detail: signup by Google, GitHub or email, then a deposit before anything runs: the billing step states 'Add initial credits (minimum $15, maximum $5,000 per transaction)' and 'Minimum deposit is $15', paid by card or USDC/USDT. The USD 15 is a minimum deposit of real money, not an authorisation hold, and there is no trial credit. Whether debit or prepaid cards are accepted is not stated
